trainer.note: v2 owns validation, PPO construction, the learn loop, receipts, and checkpointing; the v2b delegate below only rebinds the env factories (stack UNDER macro) and injects --init-model

delegate.stack_position_rationale: the ring buffer advances every NATIVE tick a macro consumes, so the policy sees true frame(t-4)/frame(t-8) context at each macro decision point, identical to the distill-v3 training layout and the probe-v5 runtime convention

initial_model.lineage: BC frame-stack final s99081671 (self-driven aim p50 20 bins, recovery 9/12) -> macro transplant s99081679: feature extractor and aim head verbatim, macro verb head from per-tick rows [wait,fire,swap] (hop dropped), value pathway fresh
initial_model.interface: macro MultiDiscrete([3, 180]) over stacked Box(3 x 22904)
initial_model.note: also injected at launch via v2b --init-model; the CLI injection and this block must agree at freeze

trainer_v2.discounting_note: gamma applies PER MACRO STEP; the macro reward is the undiscounted per-tick sum over the ticks the macro consumed (~20-70), so 0.999 per macro is roughly 0.999^(1/40) per native tick; truncation is reward-neutral (v2 wrapper), so 24000-tick late-level truncations bootstrap instead of paying -10

levels_scope.rule: INCLUDED_LEVELS minus DUAL_POSITION_LEVELS: the macro interface exposes no hop verb, so the 6 dual-position levels are unreachable by design and are excluded from training rather than trained as guaranteed losses
levels_scope.resolved_at_freeze: confirmed against the 12-panel probe (s99081678) and the 55-level ceiling map (s99081681): the only NON-dual-position teacher failures through the macro interface are volcano9 (12-panel seed) and Coast7 (55-map seed), both timing losses with zero mask fallbacks -- interface-reachable, ACCEPTED as known-hard, and kept in training scope; no additional interface-blocked level was found; the 6 dual-position exclusions stand even though village3 and volcano3 won under the 55-map seeds (seed-dependent hopless wins do not change the designed exclusion)

environment.reward_note: score_progress_reward_cap is owned by trainer_v2 (10.0); time-limit truncation pays NO terminal penalty (v2 TruncationNeutralRewardWrapper), per the verified root-cause fixes

runs.checkpoint_note: one macro step is one policy timestep (~20-70 native ticks); at the projected 300-600 macro steps/s over 24 envs, 786432 steps is roughly every 25-45 minutes; if observed throughput is far off, adjust checkpoint_every at freeze, never mid-run

success_criteria_tiers.scope_note: all tiers are STUDENT_ONLY autonomous outcomes on engineering-seed panels; teacher-assisted or recovery-mode wins count for nothing here
success_criteria_tiers.tier_0_sanity: wrapper fidelity holds under the trained policy: shots_on_target_rate >= 0.95 on every eval, and the policy fires at >= 0.5x the teacher's macro fire rate (the BC init fires ~20x too rarely; PPO must at least not collapse further)
success_criteria_tiers.tier_1_signal: any autonomous win on any level beyond Jungle1 on the 12-panel at any checkpoint (the historical autonomous best is ~Jungle1-only on this panel)
success_criteria_tiers.tier_2_promising: at least 5 of 12 panel levels won autonomously by the final checkpoint
success_criteria_tiers.tier_3_strong: at least 20 of the 49 trained levels won autonomously in a full 49-level eval of the final model
success_criteria_tiers.failure_is_reportable: if tier 1 is not reached, the run is reported as FAIL with the per-level telemetry; no re-slicing after the fact
